_note: The events calendar. 'month' (YYYY-MM) is the month the calendar opens on until the visitor's own date takes over. 'weekly' repeats every week on that weekday (SUN, MON, TUE, WED, THU, FRI, SAT). 'events' are one-off dates (YYYY-MM-DD). 'time' is optional, written the way it should read ("7 PM"). The description pops up when someone hovers over or taps the event.

weekly.title: Taco Tuesday
weekly.description: Every Tuesday at John's Chef Table.
